channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Tag! Queer Shorts Festival 2027: Call for Submissions (Portland) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Tag! Queer Shorts Festival
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026
Award: Award categories with cash prizes (amounts not stated): Hispanic/Latine Creativity, Power of Community, Best Erotic Short and Radical Futures Student Film, plus a Festival Director's Award. Modest submission fees on FilmFreeway; fee waivers for historically excluded communities and filmmakers from countries that criminalize queer identities, and discount codes for Pacific Northwest filmmakers.

Tag! invites LGBTQIA+ filmmakers to submit finished shorts of 15 minutes or under, including credits, in any genre (theme for 2027: "You're It!"). About 40 to 45 shorts are selected. English captions are required; films made with generative AI are not programmed; no works in progress.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: AT&T Untold Stories 2027 (Tribeca Festival): USD 1.2 million film production prize (closes 18 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Tribeca Festival and AT&T
Deadline: 18 Jan 2027
Award: One winner receives USD 1,200,000 to produce the film; the four other finalists receive USD 15,000 grants each. No entry fee.

AT&T Untold Stories, now in its 10th year, is a production prize run by the Tribeca Festival and AT&T that funds a feature film from an underrepresented filmmaker. Industry judges select five projects; their filmmakers pitch to a jury of media professionals at the 2027 Tribeca Festival in June.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Oregon Media Arts Fellowship 2026 (two USD 5,000 awards for Oregon media artists)
item.description: Portland Art Museum (PAM CUT) and Oregon Arts Commission · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · Two fellowships of USD 5,000 each, no matching funds required; paid within two months of notification. No application fee.

item.title: American Academy in Rome: Rome Prize Fellowship 2027-28
item.description: American Academy in Rome · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Stipends of USD 16,000 (half-term, about 5 months) and USD 30,000 (full-term, about 10 months), plus housing, workspace and weekday meals. Approximately 30 fellowships per year. APPLICATION FEE: USD 50 by 1 November (USD 60 for multiple categories); USD 80/90 in the late window to 15 November.

item.title: Script Pipeline: First Look Project 2026 (screenplay and TV pilot contest)
item.description: Script Pipeline · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 15,000 in total prizes across six winners: USD 2,500 to the winner of each of four screenplay genre categories (Action and Sci-Fi, Comedy, Drama, Horror and Thriller) and USD 2,500 to the winner of each of two TV pilot categories (hour and half-hour). All winners also receive long-term circulation to Script Pipeline's industry network of producers, managers, agents and directors, 1-on-1 development assistance from Script Pipeline execs, additional script reviews and consideration of other material, career guidance and mentorship, and invitations to private Symposium events. Entry fee: USD 60 at the regular deadline, rising to USD 65 (late, 15 October) and USD 70 (extended, 30 October).
